# add travis

Add a Travis CI configuration to the repository, "because it's needed to encrypt some integrations": Travis offered `travis encrypt` for secrets, and the author wanted CI-side access to a credential (the integrations of the time were the Bitbucket mirror and GitHub tokens) without committing it in the clear.
